description: This Java abstract class provides helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to thing commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It includes methods for extracting authorization subjects, JSON fields, namespaces, and various Ditto model elements such as Things, Access Control Lists, Attributes, Features, and Policies from Adaptable instances.

classes.name: AbstractThingMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing helper methods to convert Adaptable objects into various Ditto model elements and to extract relevant data from Adaptables for thing command mappings.

methods.name: authorizationSubjectFrom
methods.description: Extracts an AuthorizationSubject from an Adaptable based on its payload path.

methods.name: selectedFieldsFrom
methods.description: Returns the selected JsonFieldSelector from an Adaptable's payload, if any.

methods.name: namespaceFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the namespace string from an Adaptable's topic path, returning null if it is a placeholder.

methods.name: thingFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into a Thing object.

methods.name: aclFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into an AccessControlList object.

methods.name: aclEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates an AclEntry object from an Adaptable's payload, using its path to determine the entry's key.

methods.name: attributesFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into Attributes.

methods.name: attributePointerFrom
methods.description: Generates a JsonPointer to an attribute within an Adaptable payload based on its path.

methods.name: attributeValueFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonValue of an attribute from an Adaptable.

methods.name: featureIdFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID as a String from an Adaptable based on its path.

methods.name: featuresFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into Features.

methods.name: featureFrom
methods.description: Creates a Feature object from an Adaptable's payload, using its path-based ID.

methods.name: featureDefinitionFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into a FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: featurePropertiesFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into FeatureProperties.

methods.name: featurePropertyPointerFrom
methods.description: Generates a JsonPointer to a feature property within an Adaptable based on its path.

methods.name: featurePropertyValueFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonValue of a feature property from an Adaptable.

methods.name: policyIdFrom
methods.description: Extracts a PolicyId from an Adaptable's payload value.

methods.name: thingDefinitionFrom
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable's payload value into a ThingDefinition.

methods.name: leafValue
methods.description: Retrieves the leaf value of a JsonPointer as a String.
